The fitted cut of the shirt allows for optimal adaptability to the body, ensuring unrestricted freedom of movement during sports practice. Likewise, its composition of 90% polyester and 10% elastane provides great elasticity and comfort.

To prevent chafing and ensure greater comfort, the Protec shirt uses a Flatlock flat seam system. This sewing technique allows the seams to lie flat and without relief, thus avoiding any type of skin irritation during use.

In summary, the Protec short sleeve shirt is a high-quality and functional sports product that provides protection, adaptability, freedom of movement, and comfort to rugby players.
